rationale: Seeds a scripted popup's keyboard cursor from the option its author marked as selected instead of always seeding an edge of the list, matching the native ComboBox, which already sets hover_index_ to selected_. Touching render-assets-and-backends is core/view only: web-compat-document.js gains a selectedIndexIn() helper and activate() consults it, falling back to the existing first/last edge whenever nothing is marked, so an unmarked list keeps byte-identical behaviour. Every signal read -- aria-activedescendant, aria-selected, aria-checked, the option's checked property, aria-current -- requires an explicit author mark, and no value is inferred from trigger text. No renderer, backend, font, asset or Skia pin changes; no harness, fixture, snapshot or threshold changes. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a change that crossed its selector. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
